content.text: {"candidate_id":"v710-v710-qualification-q2-run-v710q2-english-v3","content_hash":"eeaa54141318c7c5a62ea27ee4722f6fefe07826f139e85fdc240dd553499dbb","claims":[{"claim":"A description was stored as confirmed only when a dated label or accompanying document identified its subject.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"Visitors’ memories were recorded separately as possible identifications.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"The archivist explained that preserving a recollection did not require presenting it as established fact.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"The memories were kept rather than discarded.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"A letter later confirmed one visitor’s identification.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"The letter confirmed only one visitor’s identification.","basis":"unsupported"}],"passed":false,"reasons":["The explanation adds an unsupported exclusivity claim: the passage says a letter confirmed one visitor’s identification, not that it was the only identification ever confirmed."],"evidence_ids":["E1.1"],"resolution_audit":{"key":"A","key_fully_supported":true,"key_reason":"The passage gives documentary identification as the confirmation condition, records memories separately as possible identifications, and says recollections need not be presented as established fact.","unexcluded_rival_conditions":[],"distractors":[{"option":"B","decisively_wrong":true,"basis":"direct_contradiction","reason":"The passage says visitor memories were recorded separately as possible identifications, contradicting the claim that unsupported memories were discarded."},{"option":"C","decisively_wrong":true,"basis":"passage_unsupported","reason":"The passage states a documentary confirmation condition; it does not make visitor confidence a condition."},{"option":"D","decisively_wrong":true,"basis":"direct_contradiction","reason":"Memories were recorded as possible identifications before the later letter updated one visitor’s record."}]}}
